HUMAN RESOURCES DIVISION\nREQUEST FOR EM.[NULL2]: M.G.L. c. 111C, § 1 defines EMS first response vehicle as “any aircraft, boat, motor vehicle or any other means of transportation, whether privately or publicly owned, which is intended and is maintained and operated for the rapid response of EMS personnel, equipment and supplies to emergencies by an EMS first response service or by an ambulance service and is not utilized for patient transport.”
HUMAN RESOURCES DIVISION\nREQUEST FOR EM.6. Detail the reasons for requesting EMT: The city seeks selective certification to address critical vacancies among Firefighter/EMTs. A surge in multi-casualty incidents, scheduled deployment to new waterfront districts, and multiple long-term leaves have reduced daily unit availability. Several personnel are in training pipelines, temporarily decreasing the number of licensed EMTs available for field assignments. Selective certification will enable targeted hiring of candidates with current credentials to restore minimum staffing, maintain reliable ALS/BLS coverage on every shift, reduce overtime dependence, and ensure compliance with state response performance benchmarks while broader recruitment initiatives are underway.
